site: Example bench (scanning SQUID microscope, Attocube coarse positioning)
notes: Example overlay only. It lets a model request at most 20 Attocube steps per command on any axis in either direction. The limit bounds the count requested, not the steps made: the upstream writes each step command twice (atto.py:109-124, 169) and the source does not show what the ANC300 does with the second copy, so a deployment measures the steps one command makes on its bench before it sets this limit, and sets it from that, its mounting, the sample and the known touchdown height; it may forbid one direction of z by a one-sided range.

steps.reason: example only: at most 20 requested Attocube steps per command on this bench (the steps made per command are measured on the bench: the upstream writes the step command twice)
